comparison.objective: Candidate finishes installed coils by tang removal; record centers a block in a four-jaw chuck.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests coaxial impact tooling and loose-fragment collection; record requires block placement and iterative adjustment of opposing jaw pairs to center and secure it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, fragment containment, insert retention, and no damage; record requires a centered, held block and arm retreat, but supplies no numeric centering tolerance or specs.
comparison.reason: Iterative chuck centering and clamping do not test sacrificial-feature fracture, impact regulation, or fragment recovery.
